comments.text: I’ll be honest the only reason I’m doing ok in this economy is because I saved $ for two years to buy a whole cow and a giant freezer and I raise chickens, grow veggies and fruits. I spend maybe $100 a month on cleaning supplies. We use bidet so no TP cost and kitchen rags instead of paper towel. I bought everything wholesale cheap per ounce. We don’t even buy bread, we make that at home too. Ingredient only household. As vegetables grow instead of sharing I either wash and freeze or pickle them. I am a gulf war survivor so I am preparing for world war 3. I suggest ya’ll learn some basic survival skills because this upcoming period is gonna be worse than the Great Depression. The bubble is gonna pop at some point.
